desc: The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}). Short, one prompt at a time, not skippable on a new save (owner, Nov 3 DECISIONS.md). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.

options.house_cost_in: farm_build.json build.house (a little wood and 8 swings of labour)

options_doc: tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: the interact key near a site swings a hammer (one swing per swing_cooldown_s), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30). free_order: after the house is down feed, crop and meet-Hob can come in any order (false: strictly in the listed order). skippable: shows a Skip button (the owner says the farm tutorial cannot be skipped on a new save). axe_free: the tutorial hands over the axe (the Market still sells it later).

hints.go: Open the Market on the bar below and buy an axe in the Farm tab
Walk up to a wild tree and press {interact} to chop it for wood

hints.place: Press {build}, pick House (it costs a little wood), then click the marked spot
hints.wait: Your Boki are building it. Watch, or press {interact} at the house to swing a hammer too

hints.go: Press {interact} at the house to swing a hammer and help
Open your Boki's page and pick a job for it

hints.place: Press {build} and set the trough down
hints.fill: Walk up to the trough and press {interact} to fill it from your pantry

hints.patch: Press {build} and put a crop patch down
hints.plant: Plant a seed in the patch ({interact})
hints.grow: Give it a moment to grow, then pick it

hints.go: Hob draws up more buildings. Walk up and press {interact}
Ready? Step into the portal ({interact}) for your first expedition

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.

axe_toast: Someone left a spare axe by the house: it is yours
